info.title: ContentPort API
info.description: Implemented offer, development payment, creator content, webhook and health routes. The current LND payment route is local/development only; it is not the approved production Lightning Address flow.

servers.description: Same origin as the API server; paths include /api where applicable.

nostrAuth.name: Authorization
nostrAuth.description: Nostr <base64 signed NIP-98 event>. Protected POST requests also require Idempotency-Key and bind the raw body hash and key in the signed event.

speedWebhookSignature.name: webhook-signature
speedWebhookSignature.description: Speed webhook HMAC signature. The server currently does not load a Speed webhook secret, so these routes reject callbacks until that integration is configured.

get.summary: Check required database tables and connectivity

200.description: Database and required schema are available

503.description: Database or required schema is unavailable

get.summary: List published offers for brand discovery

post.description: Requires creator Nostr HTTP authorization. Without video_id, provide content_url and content_sha256. With video_id, the video must be owned and ready; the server resolves the canonical media reference and ignores client-supplied content_url or content_sha256.

example.usage_rights: Non-exclusive organic social use; no paid advertising.

get.summary: Read an offer; private drafts require creator authorization

post.summary: Validate and queue the exact creator-signed offer
Request a local LND invoice for a published offer
post.description: Development-only legacy route. It uses the single configured local LND node and does not route to a creator Lightning Address or independently prove creator-beneficiary settlement. Do not use as the production payment path.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required only when optional Nostr authorization is supplied.

get.summary: Read current offer and local LND payment status
get.description: Public legacy status endpoint. A client-visible status is not independent proof of funds movement.

200.description: Current payment and license publication summary

post.summary: Legacy Speed webhook alias (unavailable until secret configuration is implemented)
post.description: The route validates Speed HMAC headers, but the current runtime does not load a webhook secret; callbacks cannot authenticate and must not be treated as settlement evidence.

post.summary: Legacy Speed webhook (unavailable until secret configuration is implemented)
post.description: Alias of POST /api/webhooks/lightning. The current runtime does not load a webhook secret, so callbacks cannot authenticate.

get.summary: List the authenticated creator’s videos and offer relationships

post.description: Ownership comes from the authenticated Nostr public key. The upload must use a valid server-issued upload session.

201.description: Signed upload parameters; the API secret is not returned
